description: Add a record (entry) to a data model. Pass the model id or slug and a `data` object whose keys are the model's field keys (use get_model first if unsure). A product is a record too: pass a model whose product capability is enabled (get_model shows `product.enabled`), and list_products then lists it with its stock. Each record carries `url`: its live storefront link, built by the server from the model's urlPattern and the site's public site URL. Use it whenever you link to a record and never build a storefront URL yourself (not from a slug, not from the site address). When url is null or missing, say why instead of guessing: the model has no urlPattern (set it with update_model), the model is not delivered (deliveryAccess none, or it is the login model), the site has no public site URL, or the record - or one it links to - is unpublished.

data.description: Field values keyed by the model's field keys. A translatable field (localized: true on the model) takes a language map, e.g. { title: { en: 'Ball bearing', pl: 'Łożysko' } }

modelIdOrSlug.description: The target model's id or slug (from list_models)

published.description: Whether the record goes live on the site and delivery API (default true). false creates it hidden from every public read until published; the workspace draft secret still previews it.

name: create_record
title: Create record
